body.name: Exact \(q=2\) GATE outcome class
body.construction: Following the \(q=2\) moment-restricted GATE class in Kandiros--Harshaw--S\'{a}vje (2026), Section 2.1, define \[\mathcal M(G,\tau_{\mathrm{GATE}},2)=\left\{y=(y_i)_{i\in V_n}: y\text{ satisfies }\texttt{ass:fixed-schedule},\ \texttt{ass:ani},\ \texttt{ass:treated-endpoint-second-moment},\ \text{and }\texttt{ass:control-endpoint-second-moment}\text{ at index }n\right\}.\]
